title: Kashmiri Kahwa
description: A fragrant Kashmiri green tea infused with saffron, cardamom and cinnamon and finished with chopped almonds.
steps: Bring the 400 ml of water to a boil with the cinnamon stick and cardamom and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the saffron and sugar and simmer for 1 minute.
Add the green tea and rose petals, switch off the heat and cover for 2 minutes.
Strain into cups and top with the sliced almonds.
